fields.name: SPACE & AIRBORNE SYSTEMS
fields.description: Space and Airborne Systems is a leading provider of full mission solutions as a prime and subsystem integrator in the space, airborne and cyber domains. We provide top-tier capabilities in the design, development, integration, production and sustainment of major weapons systems for defense primes and national security, civil government and international customers.

fields.name: SPACE & MISSION SYSTEMS
fields.description: SPACE & MISSION SYSTEMS is a segment of business at L3Harris Technologies, inc. that focuses on providing space and mission systems solutions to customers. This segment includes a wide range of products and services, such as satellite communications, space-based sensors, and mission planning and execution support.
